row.title: A drill that never reaches the code it tests is a false pass
row.body: The model-retirement drill retired one vendor at a time with every credential bound; GitHub Models rungs sit first, so the Workers AI heal route never ran (0 healed). A second pass with only the Workers AI rungs exercised it. Drills must report what they exercised.

title: A drill that never reaches the code it tests is a false pass
